updates.title: How a paper gets a red flag
updates.summary: The first post in a series on how the screening works: what paper laundering is, what each label means and does not mean, and the five steps from submission to a request for human review.

updates.title: Finding the source
updates.summary: We rebuilt the step that finds candidate sources: a full-text search over 2.92M arXiv papers and a small source selector. On the public PAN200 benchmark, a true source reaches the top 3 for 93.5% of papers, against 74.5% before.

updates.title: Public screening of ICLR 2027 starts tonight
updates.summary: Stage 1 starts at 9:00 PM ET. Five sessions run at once, started a few at a time. Each paper is checked against earlier public work, and every step is shown on the live page.
